the book is its mark

a day with nothing coming says nothing
a figure under nought keeps a hyphen
Next lot shares the cover's line
the table is the old one
the columns take no shares

the table has no meter
the rows and the table both show wide
the next lot wraps
a tick does not read the stock
a failed tick clears the rows
no books keeps the old rows
